items.title: Pierre Merlin Interview, 1961-08-14
items.q: I met Claude Luther, and I played with him and other friends for six years, from 1943 to 1949.

ctx.x: And did these people become professional musicians later?

One or two of them. Who were they? Or, now I don't know. One is a lawyer in Africa. One is a photographer. The other, I don't know. I don't know. And then I came in Paris, in Paris. And I was in art school for years. And I met Claude Luther, and I played with him and other friends for six years, from 1943 to 1949.

Under the Germans? They let you play jazz? The Germans? Germans? Allemands? No. I mean the Nazis did not stop you from playing jazz? They allowed jazz? I don't understand. Allemands? How do you say it? No, no. Deutsch? The Germans didn't stop you from playing jazz?
